title: Fil Olmak İsteyen Fare
author: Öznur Karaeloğlu
description: Kuyruklu is a little mouse who lives far away from his family. His tail is much longer than that of an ordinary mouse, and he is not at all happy about it. One day, an elephant performing in a visiting circus catches his attention. Convinced that the elephant is strong and fortunate, Kuyruklu longs to be just like him, but is the elephant really as powerful and lucky as he seems?
english_title: The Mouse That Wanted To Be An Elephant
